items.title: Google Launches Gmail End-to-End Encryption for Android and iOS
items.description: Google has officially rolled out End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) for the Gmail application on Android and iOS devices. This major update targets users utilizing Gmail client-side encryption. It allows organisations to handle sensitive data confidentially directly from their smartphones or tablets.
